goal.currentDescriptionEn: The learner can explain that between any two distinct rational numbers there are always infinitely many further rational numbers and provide examples.
goal.currentTitleDe: Dichtheit der rationalen Zahlen erläutern
goal.currentTitleEn: Explain the density of rational numbers
